correctness.rationale: Each adjacent two-column face must be hit, so the occupied columns cover the odd base cycle and number at least k+1. At equality the k empty columns have gaps of size two except for one of size three, so the occupied support has just one consecutive pair. A deletion of k+1 vertices leaves 3k+1 vertices and 3k plus the number of edges within the deleted set, forcing the deleted set to be independent for a forest. Conversely opposite levels on the consecutive pair give a connected complement: the unoccupied columns give a chain of retained rungs connected through intervening single retained vertices, with one end vertex attaching at each end. The complement is then a tree. For a changed support, removing one empty column merges two consecutive gaps: length four admits only the original placement and length five admits exactly one alternative. Thus only the two stated neighboring supports are possible. The unchanged bits and the new opposite level give the stated transfer and its inverse. Full base travel acts by T^(2k+1)=T, since T^k complements all bits; then one can change the first bit as well as freely flipping all other bits in a fiber. All moves change parity. Four crossings in a length-four walk in the base cycle must include consecutive reversal, which retraces the same lifted edge; with two crossings a simple square must have one internal flip on each side. Exactly k-2 flips carry to flips allowed on the other side in each direction. Together with the stationary-fiber squares this gives the stated incidences divided by four, including zero at k=2. Independent replay python3 -B /workspace/reproduce_frozen.py 3: exhaustive leaf stripping and direct symmetric differences agree with every labeled configuration and exchange for n=5,7,9,11; direct closed-walk counts give 0,42,252,1056 squares. The infinite conclusion is from the proof, not those finite checks.

evidence: The mirrored RESULT.md gives k nonconsecutive empty columns, one pair of consecutive single columns with opposite selected rails and arbitrary choices elsewhere; this gives (2k+1)2^k. Complementation gives the same family of maximum induced trees at order 3k+1.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The indexed classification is equivalent, not a numerical coincidence. The difference is at the edge level: the slide rule requires endpoints adjacent in the prism. A forward jump moves the selected vertex from column i+1 to i+2, and is a slide only when its rail equals the new rail, i.e. v_1=v_2 in the frozen coordinates; jumps do not have that restriction.

value.rationale: The explicit unrestricted exchange graph determines much more than optimum size, number or reachability. Its transfer identifies every allowable move and exposes a cyclic bit action; the square census counts alternate two-step routes generated by those moves. This makes the natural odd-prism family a reusable exact model for minimum-FVS reconfiguration, including the boundary case with no squares.
